title: Demonstratives in the plural genitive
focus: Use näiden, noiden or niiden before a plural genitive noun: näiden talojen ovet (“the doors of these houses”).
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive

exercises.prompt: Complete “The doors of these houses.” ____ ovet. Reference: near the speaker. Noun: talojen.
exercises.explanation: For the reference near the speaker, use näiden/näitten. The demonstrative and talojen share plural genitive case. Also accepted here: näitten talojen.
